mentions.name: march
mentions.description: A functional programming language with a capability system that doesn't require threading capabilities through every call via an effect. The ecosystem also includes a package manager, a cargo-like build tool, and hoogle-like code search. It is usable today, though capability features are only available on main/nightly rather than the last numbered release, and it can be tried in the browser via a js_of_ocaml playground on the project site.
mentions.problem: Started as an excuse to read PLT papers and to build an easily readable syntax for exploring language-design ideas.
mentions.source_excerpt: I’m working on a programming language[1] that started as an excuse to read PLT papers and build a syntax I could easily read to help explore some ideas. I ended up building a functional language with a capability system that doesn’t require you to thread capabilities through every call with an effect. I also ended up building a package manager, cargo like tool, hoogle like code search, and a slew of other features.
mentions.author: ch4s3
